Mysterious Space.

Twelve figures were all paying close attention to Lin Yuan.

Even though Lin Yuan could only accept one of them as his master in the end, everyone was curious about which stone statue Lin Yuan would ultimately choose to comprehend.

The one hundred thirty-six stone statues in the Seventh Star Cave all contain evolutionary paths of at least the Sixth Rank,

As for those more than ten stone statues exceeding ten meters in height, they contain evolutionary paths that surpass the Sixth Rank.

Of course, these are also the most difficult stone statues to comprehend,

...

The rules of the evolutionary paths that surpass the Sixth Rank are profoundly mysterious, and it’s unknown how much they exceed the typical Sixth Rank evolutionary paths.

One can only imagine the difficulty of comprehending them.

Even if one only needs to comprehend the Third Rank Chapter or Fourth Rank Chapter that corresponds to their own strength,

it’s as difficult as ascending to the heavens.

This is also why the tablet in the Seventh Star Cave advises everyone to act according to their capabilities.

If one forcibly tries to comprehend those ten-plus stone statues, and ends up running out of time, they might be directly eliminated.

“Huh? Why is he going to choose the ‘Skywind’ stone statue?”

“Could it be that Lin Yuan is compatible with the ‘Wind’ rule?”

“The Skywind Evolutionary Path is at the Sixth Rank level. Although it’s not as impressive as those sixteen stone statues, it’s still pretty decent…”

…

Upon seeing Lin Yuan stopping in front of the ‘Spread-Winged Roc’ stone statue, the twelve figures started discussing among themselves.

“It’s also possible he just wants to have a look.”

“Right, no examiner finds the right stone statue for themselves right off the bat.”

“Didn’t those three Red Patternn Examiners also take a while to finally decide which stone statue to comprehend?”

The twelve figures speculated out loud.

“The Skywind Evolutionary Path?”

Gu Ze was slightly startled; he was not adept at the ‘Wind’ rule, so if Lin Yuan chooses this stone statue…

Gu Ze glanced at his second senior brother.

He remembered that his second senior brother’s path should contain the ‘Wind’ rule, right?

…

“The Skywind Evolutionary Path?”

Lin Yuan opened his eyes, his mind flickering through details of this particular evolutionary path.

“This is a Sixth Rank evolutionary path, and it’s much more profound than the Pagoda Evolution Path…”

Lin Yuan felt a surge of joy in his heart, as even among Sixth Rank evolutionary paths, there are levels of depth.

This depends on the level of the creator of the evolutionary path.

And Lin Yuan could clearly feel that the exposition on the essence of the ‘Wind’ rule within the Skywind Evolutionary Path was much more complete.

“The winds of heaven and earth…”

Lin Yuan took a deep breath.

Wind is everywhere, seemingly gentle, yet it can also display a violent side.

The Skywind Evolutionary Path, the rules of wind it portrayed, are of course only a small part of the overall ‘Wind’ rule.

Yet even so, it greatly benefited Lin Yuan.

“The winds of heaven and earth, they too are Taiji.”

Lin Yuan quickly absorbed the essence of the Skywind Evolutionary Path, continually perfecting the Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

Taiji gives birth to all things, embracing all things.

Half an hour later.

Lin Yuan opened his eyes once again.

The Skywind Evolutionary Path was of great help and had a significant impact on him, but at the moment, the pressing priority was not to ponder on the Skywind Evolutionary Path over and over…

Lin Yuan raised his head.

He looked towards the other one hundred or more stone statues.

His eyes inevitably shone with eagerness.

Sixth Rank evolutionary paths, if placed on the Alliance Mall APP, would be worth at least several billion.

But now, they were piled up in front of him.

And furthermore—

Lin Yuan’s gaze lingered on those sixteen stone statues exceeding ten meters in height.

If stone statues containing Sixth Rank evolutionary paths are only two or three meters tall,

then wouldn’t those exceeding ten meters contain evolutionary paths that surpass the Sixth Rank?

Thinking this, Lin Yuan took a deep breath.

Evolutionary paths that surpass the Sixth Rank, he could not even find them on the mall APP, due to a lack of the necessary permissions.

So far,

The only evolutionary path that surpassed the Sixth Rank Lin Yuan had come into contact with

was the ‘Ancient God’ Evolution Path practiced by Fang Qing.

However, the ‘Ancient God’ Evolution Path has many restrictions on cultivation,

and Lin Yuan could not obtain the complete path,

only being able to communicate by sparring and slowly comprehending with Fang Qing.

But now.

Such evolutionary paths of this caliber, sixteen in total, were laid out in front of Lin Yuan.

“One at a time.”

“There’s no need to rush, there’s a whole month’s time.”

Lin Yuan steadied himself and turned his head again to look at the ‘Spread-Winged Roc’ stone statue in front of him.

According to the rules of passing the Seven Star Cave, as long as one comprehends an evolutionary path from a stone statue,

then touches the statue by hand,

gathering the essence of that evolutionary path to inject into the statue,

they would pass the Seven Star Cave.

In a certain sense, Lin Yuan had already passed the test.

After all, he had already comprehended the ‘Skywind’ Evolutionary Path,

and could at any time gather the essence of that evolutionary path.

But Lin Yuan glanced at the other one hundred plus evolutionary paths and decided to stay a little longer.

After all, as long as he passes the test within a month, there’s no criterion regarding the duration of time taken.

“Next one.”

Lin Yuan stood up and walked towards the closest stone statue.

This statue resembled a lifelike mouse and seemed to subtly contain a chunk of earth within it.

…

Mysterious Space.

The twelve figures saw Lin Yuan leaving the ‘Spread-Winged Roc’ stone statue with mixed emotions, some relaxed, some regretful.

“It seems the Skywind Evolutionary Path is not suitable after all.”

“True, when you think about it, Lin Yuan has comprehended rules related to Yin affiliation and Yang affiliation. Even if there are evolutionary paths that are more suitable for him, they’re not related to wind attributes.”

“There’s still plenty of time, let’s just watch slowly. Although the stone statues contain complete evolutionary paths, comprehending them is not so easy to achieve…”

The twelve figures conversed with each other, their tones relaxed.

Their focus was not solely on Lin Yuan but also on those three Red Patternn Examiners.

At the moment, the three Red Patternn Examiners were each sitting under different stone statues.

The silver-haired girl, Yin Ling, was seated in front of a ‘Rubik’s Cube’ stone statue that stood twelve meters high, but at times seemed as small as a fist.
